verdict.rationale: Open WebUI ships first-party Automations and Scheduled Tasks that run prompts automatically on recurring schedules, with each run going through the normal chat pipeline. These are time-based triggers, not rules that fire on arbitrary events. Message-level hooks exist only as Python Functions and Filters that developers must write, and the documented webhooks are notification and inbound-post features rather than a rule engine. Missing for 10: user-definable event-condition-action rules, triggers on non-time events (e.g., new file, message, or external event) without custom code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
